segments.label: Orientation
segments.instruction: Name the question, audience, material stake, and what the video will not establish.

segments.label: Evidence anchor
segments.instruction: State one atomic claim; show source, date, scope, and verification status on screen.

segments.label: Why it matters
segments.instruction: Connect the claim to a concrete decision without threat inflation or identity pressure.

segments.label: Mechanism with limits
segments.instruction: Explain the proposed mechanism, competing explanations, boundary conditions, and inference level.

segments.label: Example
segments.instruction: Walk through a representative case; label constructed or historical material.

segments.label: Counterexample
segments.instruction: Show where the framework fails, where evidence is absent, and what requires escalation.

segments.label: Platform layer
segments.instruction: State only dated first-party eligibility or recommendation information; disclaim reach prediction.

segments.label: Audience choice
segments.instruction: Identify who may use, pause, reject, or seek another source; disclose material interests.

segments.label: Bounded action
segments.instruction: Offer one proportionate action with owner, inputs, stop condition, and review point.

segments.label: Recap and provenance
segments.instruction: Repeat claim, uncertainty, sources, date, corrections path, and what the content cannot establish.
